reply:
The jobs queue now holds a heavy command until its RAM fits.

## How it decides
Each heavy command has a RAM estimate in `pkg/memgate`. A command waits while the commit charge plus its estimate would pass the RAM.

## What you will see
A waiting command shows on the Jobs popover with its estimate and the time it has waited.

## What changed for agents
Nothing they type changes; the Claude mod and the pi extension call `wsh jobslot` before each command.

## Risk
A command whose estimate is far too high waits forever on an 8 GB machine; the popover's Skip is the way out.
